newsitem.title: PERU: Peru's credit to private sector up 3.9 pct in Oct.
newsitem.headline: Peru's credit to private sector up 3.9 pct in Oct.

text.p: Credit from Peru's banking system to the private sector stood at 27.850 billion soles at the end of October, up 3.9 percent from a month earlier, the Central Reserve Bank said Tuesday.

Local currency loans to the private sector totalled 7.309 billion soles at the end of October, up 2.1 percent from the month before, while foreign currency loans were $7.993 billion, also up 2.1 percent from September.
Bank credit to the private sector stood at 20.082 billion soles at the end of 1995, compared with 13.934 billion a year earlier.
